t0: Only an administrator of this repository can rename it, change who may see it, change its default branch, archive it or delete it. You can read it

t8: This repository is archived: it takes no pushes.

t12: It stops being served and listed: clones, pushes, pull requests and webhooks of it stop working at once. Its data is kept in the server's trash, not erased, but there is no button here to bring it back.
t13: Deleting takes the repository out of service.
